comment: Phase B shadow-only. 'live' would enable future economic actions; 'disabled' bypasses detection entirely.

appreciation.rationale: roughly one full stop-distance of typical V1 entries (PBF stop is 6.9% below entry); a move of this size materially changes the position context

peak_giveback.rationale: fires only after a real move (same appreciation floor) then surrendering >=50% of the peak gain

adverse_acceleration.rationale: MAE beyond 1.25x the position's own entry stop distance = materially worse than the planned risk envelope; fallback used only when no stop distance is derivable

horizon_review.rationale: fires when an explicit date in the reevaluation/horizon text is reached; descriptive horizons without dates never fire

catalyst.rationale: requires a news/event source not wired in Phase B; schema reserved, production disabled

debounce.rationale: one fire per family per ~2 sessions; re-arm only after the metric retreats 20% of the threshold value
